scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Have you
found Annon?
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
你找到安农了吗？

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
You haven't
found him yet?
Then where the
is he, then?!
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
你还没找到他？
那他在哪里啊？！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Oh well...
I'm not sure if I can believe everything you said, but since you found the ring for me, that's good enough. Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
算了...
我不确定是否该完全相信你说的，但既然你帮我找到了戒指，那就够了。谢谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
If you happen to meet Annon during your travels, tell him to come back right away. You can go ahead and continue your adventures now~
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
如果你在旅途中遇到安农，告诉他马上回来。你可以继续你的冒险了~

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
If I ever
see him again...
He will be ^660000punished^000000...
^666666*grinds teeth*^000000

[Shuda]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
You haven't
found Annon yet?
I see. Oh well, it's alright.
Time isn't an issue for us.
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
^666666*叹气...*^000000
你还没找到安农？
我知道了。算了，没关系。
时间对我们来说不是问题。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
And by 'us,' I mean '^660000you^000000.' I don't care about your plans or whatever else you may have scheduled, because you're going to make
time for me! Oho ho ho ho ho!
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
这里的“我们”指的是“^660000你^000000”。我不在乎你的计划或其他安排，因为你要为我腾出时间！哦呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Ah... Is it...?!!
Yes, that's it!
My engagement ring that was
thrown into the water by that stupid Annon!
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
啊...是...吗？！
没错，就是这个！
被那个愚蠢的安农扔进水里的订婚戒指！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Thank you so much! In your honor, our first seven kids will be named after you! Oho ho ho ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
非常感谢！为了纪念你，我们的前七个孩子都会以你的名字命名！哦呵呵呵呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Now...
All I gotta do
is find Annon.
Where the hell
did that moron go?!
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
现在...
我只需要找到安农。
那个蠢货到底跑到哪里去了？！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
^666666*Ahem*^000000
I-I didn't mean
to scare him, all I wanted was
my engagement ring back.
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
^666666*咳咳*^000000
我...我不是故意吓他的，我只是想把我的订婚戒指拿回来。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
^666666*Sigh*^000000
I guess the days
of being a happy bride
are still far away from me...
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
^666666*叹气*^000000
看来成为幸福新娘的日子还遥遥无期...

scripts.text:
^3355FFShuda gazes directly
at you with a puppy eyed look.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF舒达用小狗般的眼神直直地盯着你。^000000

scripts.text: D-Don't look at me that way!
scripts.translation: 别那样看着我！

scripts.text: Alright, alright.
scripts.translation: 好吧，好吧。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Oh come on, you know everything that happened, and I know you're gonna continue adventuring
around this area.
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
拜托了，你知道发生的一切，而且我知道你还会在这个地区继续冒险。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
I was just asking you to find Annon while you do that. Now, isn't that such a small favor? Thank you for doing this for me~
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
我只是想让你顺便找找安农。这难道不是个小忙吗？谢谢你为我做这件事~

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
In the meantime, I'll think of how I'm gonna pay back Annon for leaving me in misery! So hurry and find Annon! Hoo ho ho ho ho!
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
在此期间，我会想想怎么报复安农让我这么痛苦！快去找到安农！呼呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(She's so scary!
Making me do stuff
for her again...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（她好可怕！
又让我为她做事...）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Why am I always
doing things for other
people anyway?!)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我为什么总是在为别人做事呢？！）

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Yes, I knew I could count on you! So find Annon! It's my destiny to make him ^660000mine^000000. Hoo ho ho ho ho!
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
没错，我就知道可以指望你！快去找到安农！让他成为^660000我的^000000，这是我的命运。呼呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
I haven't seen him around the village for a while. And I don't think he jumped into the water to find my ring, since he's too sissy for that. He probably doesn't have the guts to see me without it.
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
我在村子里好久没见到他了。我觉得他也不会跳进水里去找我的戒指，因为他太胆小了。没有戒指，他大概没脸来见我。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Will you please tell Annon that
I got my ring back so he can come back to me now? I hope you'll remember that for me, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
请告诉安农，我已经找回戒指了，让他现在回来找我好吗？我希望你能记住这件事，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Huh...?
Did you find my ring?
Show me, show it to me!
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
咦...？
你找到我的戒指了？
快给我看看，给我看看！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
What the...
You got nothing!
Don't lie to me,
bring me my ring!
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
什么...？
你什么都没找到！
别骗我，把我的戒指拿来！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Hurry up and find
my ring. I'll be waiting
here for the good news.
Oho ho ho ho ho~!
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
快点找到我的戒指。我会在这里等待好消息。
哦呵呵呵呵呵~！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
I feel a little bad asking you this, especially since you're
an outsider.
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
让你做这件事，我有点过意不去，尤其是你还是个外人。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
But that ring is really important to me. If you could find it for me, I'd be the happiest woman in the whole world.
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
但那枚戒指对我来说真的很重要。如果你能帮我找到它，我将会是世界上最幸福的女人。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
So please, I beg you.
Please bring my ring back to me.
I want to live with Annon as a happy couple forever. Can't you understand that?!
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
所以拜托了，求求你了。
请把我的戒指还给我。
我想和安农永远幸福地生活在一起。你难道不明白吗？！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
Umm...?
Ah, you must be one of the tourists. I'd guide you around and listen to your stories about the outside world, but...
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
嗯...？
啊，你一定是游客吧。我本想带你四处逛逛，听听你讲讲外面的世界，但是...

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
I'm reeeally
busy right now.
So very busy.
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
我现在真的
非常非常忙。
忙得不得了。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
Huh...?
You don't think I look busy just because I'm standing on one spot and not moving at all?! Oh. My. God. You're so rude!
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
咦...？
难道你觉得我只是站在这里不动，就不算忙吗？！天哪。你太没礼貌了！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
Now, I've got to find my
engagement ring. If only
my fiancee hadn't
thrown it...
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
现在，我得去找我的
蓝宝戒指。要是我的未婚夫
没有把它扔出去就好了...

scripts.text: What...?
Lies~!
scripts.translation: 骗子~！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
What 'what?'
You still think I'm
standing around for my
own amusement or something?!
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
什么叫“什么”？
你还以为我站在这里
是为了自己开心什么的吗？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No no no no...
I meant, I can't
believe that you're
engaged to someone!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不不不不...
我是说，我简直不敢相信
你竟然订婚了！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
Wwwwaaaaaahhhhh!
Wh-who are you to say
something so rude to such a nice lady like myself. Go away, I don't wanna talk to you!
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
哇啊啊啊啊啊！
你算哪根葱，敢对像我这样
温柔的女士说这种无礼的话。滚开，我不想理你！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
What lies?
I'm not gonna put up with crap
if you're gonna say something like 'I can't believe you're engaged to someone!'
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
什么骗子？
如果你要说“我简直不敢相信你订婚了”这种话，
我可不会容忍这种废话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa whoa whoa~
Calm down, lady.
Hear me out first.
What I'm wondering is...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀哎呀~
冷静点，女士。
先听我说完。
我想知道的是...

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
I know, I know.
You're wondering why I'm
standing near the water, right? Well, it's because my ring was thrown there and I've gotta
get it back.
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
我知道，我知道。
你肯定在想，我为什么站在水边，对吧？
因为我的戒指被扔进水里了，我必须把它拿回来。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
What am I doing, talking to a tourist like this? ^666666*Sigh...*^000000 Well, you learned what you wanted to know. I hope you're satisfied now.
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
我这是在干什么，跟一个游客聊这些？^666666*叹气*^000000
好吧，你已经知道了你想知道的事。希望你满意了。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
...
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
...

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
...
......

[Powerful-Looking Woman]
...
......
........Hey.

[Powerful-Looking Woman]
Why are you staring at me?
Don't you have anything to do?
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
你一直盯着我看干什么？
难道你没事做吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: No~ and you are an interesting girl.
scripts.translation: 没有~ 而且你是个很有趣的女孩。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
I see. Hmmm...
You're kind of my type.
No no, that doesn't mean I'm interested in you. Plus I'm
already engaged.
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
是吗。嗯...
你挺合我眼缘的。
不不，这不代表我对你有意思。况且我已经订婚了。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
I see. Hmmm...
You're kind of my type.
Before you think of anything weird, I meant that I think you and me are a lot alike.
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
是吗。嗯...
你挺合我眼缘的。
在你胡思乱想之前，我是说我觉得我们俩很像。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
Let me introduce myself.
My name is Shuda, I've lived in Ayothaya all my life. Since you don't have anything to do, I have
a favor to ask of you.
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
让我自我介绍一下。
我叫舒达，在哎哟泰雅长大。既然你没事做，我有件事想拜托你。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
My fiance Annon is always interested in things other than me. I don't understand why, and I don't think I deserve to be ignored!
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
我的未婚夫安农总是对除了我以外的事情感兴趣。我不明白为什么，我觉得我不应该被忽视！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Anyways, we're engaged
and we got rings for each other...
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
^666666*叹气*^000000
总之，我们订婚了，
我们互相送了戒指...

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
I thought being engaged would improve our relationship. But he just took my ring and threw it into the water.
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
我以为订婚会让我们的关系变好。但他却拿走了我的戒指，扔进了水里。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
I got upset and yelled at him to get my ring back for me, and then
I never saw him after that.
So what I want to ask is...
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
我很生气，冲他大喊让他把戒指给我拿回来，然后我就再也没见过他。
所以我想问的是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You want me
to find your
ring, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是想让我
帮你找回
戒指，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Ah...
So you know
what I want.
That makes it
much simpler.
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
啊...
原来你知道
我想要什么。
那就简单多了。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
And once I retrieve
the ring, I'll make
him treat me to a much
deserved vacation in Jawaii...
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
等我拿回
戒指，我会让他
带我去爪哇
享受一场应得的假期...

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
...Where I will
^660000enslave^000000 him.
^666666*Grinds teeth*^000000

[{0}]
(...H-Horrifying!)

[Shuda]
So anyway, I want you to go out and find my engagement ring. Since the water is calm and still around here, the ring is probably still under the water, and hasn't been swept away yet.
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
总之，我要你出去把我的蓝宝戒指找回来。既然这里的水很平静，戒指应该还在水下，还没被冲走。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
And so, that is my quest for you. It should keep you entertained for a while. So get into the water, and I'll supervise from here.
Oho ho ho ho ho!
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
这就是交给你的任务。应该能让你消遣一会儿。
快下水吧，我在这里看着。
哦呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Are you gonna just stare and
not help at all? I thought the word adventurer was synonymous
with 'hero,' not 'lazy.'
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
^666666*叹气*^000000
你就打算这么干看着，一点忙都不帮吗？
我以为“冒险者”这个词等同于“英雄”，而不是“懒散”呢。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
Oh I see...
Don't help strangers, do you?
Well, my name is Shuda, a beautiful damsel waiting for her engagement ring to rise up from the water.
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
哦，我明白了...
你不帮陌生人，是吗？
好吧，我叫舒达，是一位美丽的淑女，正等待着我的蓝宝戒指从水里浮上来。

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
There...!
We're not
strangers anymore!
Oho ho ho ho ho!
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
好了！
我们
不再是
陌生人了！
哦呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Don't you pity me, and my tragic situation? If someone were to help this precious maiden find her ring, she'd be the happiest bride in the whole world.
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
你不觉得可怜吗，可怜我这种悲惨的处境？
如果有人能帮这位珍贵的淑女找回戒指，她将成为全世界最幸福的新娘。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
And her savior
would be known as
the hero of Ayothaya.
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
而她的救星
将会被世人称为
哎哟泰雅的英雄。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
 ...Say what?!

[Shuda]
Basically, you're gonna find my engagement ring, and I'll be the happiest bride in the whole world and I'll live happily ever after. What's so hard to understand
about that?
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
简单来说，你要帮我找回蓝宝戒指，然后我会成为全世界最幸福的新娘，从此过上幸福的生活。
这有什么难懂的吗？

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Sure, Annon, he's my fiancee, is spineless and disappears whenever
I say something a little too harsh. What a little girl! Can't he see I'm trying to make him a better man?!
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
没错，安农，我的未婚夫，是个没骨头的胆小鬼，只要我说得稍微严厉一点他就消失得无影无踪。
真是个小女孩！他难道看不出我是想把他培养成一个更好的男人吗？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He ran away
from you, didn't he?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他是不是
被你吓跑了？

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
Eh...?
What was that?
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
呃...？
你刚才说什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^666666*Ahem*^000000
You're way
too good for him.
(I'd have run away myself!)

[Shuda]
Yes, yes, I know.
But what's important
is that once I get my ring back, Annon will be permanently mine. Till ^660000death do we part^000000.
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
是的，是的，我知道。
但重要的是，一旦我拿回戒指，安农就永远属于我了。直到^660000死亡将我们分离^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
So, are you
gonna help me or what?!
If you do, me and Annon are gonna name our first seven children after you.
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
所以，你到底帮不帮我？！
如果你帮了，我和安农会把我们前七个孩子都取你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Shuda]
So go and look under the water! There's no water current, so I'm sure it's still there! What are you waiting for, it's should be an easy swim for you! Oho ho ho ho ho!
scripts.translation:
[舒达]
快去水下找找看！这里没有水流，我确信它还在！
你在等什么，对你来说这应该是个轻松的游泳任务！哦呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Why isn't it coming up from the water? Maybe if I stirred around with a wooden stick...?
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
^666666*叹气*^000000
为什么它不从水里浮上来呢？
也许我用木棍搅一搅...？

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
...?!
What are you
looking at?!
I'm busy, so if you
want something
I can't help you!
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
...？！
你在看什么？！
我很忙，如果你有什么事
我帮不了你！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
^666666Stupid tourists, running
around all over Ayothaya,
pestering and bothering
beautiful girls like me...^000000
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
^666666这些愚蠢的游客，
在哎哟泰雅到处乱跑，
打扰和骚扰像我这样
美丽的女孩...^000000

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Where the
hell is it!?
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
^666666*叹气*^000000
该死的，
它到底在哪里？！

scripts.text:
[Powerful-Looking Woman]
What are
you looking at?
Haven't you ever seen a delicate damsel sigh before? Leave me the hell alone!
scripts.translation:
[身形强壮的女子]
你在看什么？
你以前没见过
淑女叹气吗？
给我滚开！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A blood stain?
What's going on?
I should take a look...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
血迹？
发生什么事了？
我得去看看...

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnder a giant tree,
you find some bushes with
blood smudged on some
of the leaves.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在一棵巨大的树下，
你发现了一些灌木丛，
有些叶子上沾着血迹。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWithin the bushes, you see
that the trail of blood continues, almost as if a bleeding animal struggled to find refuge within
the bushes.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在灌木丛中，
你看到血迹的轨迹延伸着，
仿佛一只受伤的野兽
曾挣扎着躲进灌木丛里。^000000

scripts.text: Scatter the bushes.
scripts.translation: 拨开灌木丛

scripts.text: Dig up the bushes.
scripts.translation: 挖开灌木丛

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^666666*Cough cough*^000000
It's so dusty!

[?]
...Awwww
Oh... Oh God...!

[{0}]
Huh...?
I heard something
from below! Let's
dig it up!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦...？
我听到下面有动静！
让我挖开看看！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou pull up the bushes,
^3355FFand beneath the dust and
^3355FFshrubbery, you find
a small burrow.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你拔起灌木丛，
^3355FF在灰尘和枝叶之下，
^3355FF你发现了一个
小小的洞穴。^000000

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
^666666*Cough cough!*^000000
Wh...who's there?
Shuda?! If that's you,
stay back, or I'll kill myself!
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
^666666*咳咳！*^000000
谁...谁在那儿？
舒达？！如果是你，
就站远点，否则我就自杀了！

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: I'm not Shuda!
scripts.translation: 我不是舒达！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey...
What are you doi--
^3355FFHe vanished!^000000

[Haggard Man]
Hmmm...?
I sense kindess, sincerity and a general love for mankind in your voice. Verily, you are not Shuda.
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
嗯...？
我从你的声音中感受到了
善意、真诚以及对人类的普遍关爱。
确实，你不是舒达。

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
You are unfamiliar to me, outsider. I'm unsure of how you found my hiding place, but if you have something to say, make it short!
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
我不认识你，外来者。
我不知道你是怎么找到我的藏身之处的，
但如果你有话要说，请长话短说！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou dig up the bushes, stirring
up a large, choking cloud of dust.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你挖开灌木丛，
扬起了一大团呛人的灰尘。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^666666*Cough cough!*^000000
What a large,
choking cloud
of dust!

^3355FFAs you dig up the bushes, the ground beneath one of the bushes crumbles and you hear a scream
from beneath.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你挖开灌木丛时，
其中一丛下方的地面塌陷了，
你听到下面传来一声尖叫。^000000

scripts.text:
[?]
^666666*Cough cough*^000000
...M-my legs!

[{0}]
Hmmm...?
What was that noise?
Ugh, it's awfully dusty.
I better stop digging.
^666666*cough cough cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...？
刚才那是什么声音？
唉，灰尘好大。
还是先停止挖掘吧。
^666666*咳咳咳*^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou find that the burrow is empty. It seems Annon has found a new hiding place.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现洞穴是空的。看来安农已经找到了新的藏身之处。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou find a pile of dead bushes under a large tree. The area around the bushes seems awfully dusty.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你在大树下发现了一堆枯死的灌木。灌木周围的地面似乎积满了灰尘。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That looks
like blood!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那看起来
像是血迹！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm...
Yes...
That's definitely blood.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...
是的...
那绝对是血迹。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Strange to see
a blood stain in
this kind of place...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在这种地方
看到血迹
真是奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
^666666*...Cough cough*^000000
No...! My hiding place!

[Haggard Man]
Hmmm...?
I'm bleeding?!
Oh, how did this happen?
My spiritual training wasn't supposed to go like this...!
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
嗯...？
我在流血？！
噢，这是怎么回事？
我的精神修炼不应该变成这样...！

scripts.text: Treat his wound first.
scripts.translation: 先处理他的伤口

scripts.text: Is that you, Annon?
scripts.translation: 是你吗，安农？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyway, I think you need to be treated. Let me check if I have some potions.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
总之，我觉得你需要治疗。让我看看有没有带药水。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah...
Here we are,
a White Potion.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...
在这里，
一瓶白色药水。

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
You mean the White Potion,
the ultimate drink for healing?
I appreciate you doing me this favor. ^666666*Phew*^000000 Now, I feel much better.
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
你是说白色药水，
那种终极的治愈饮品？
谢谢你帮我这个忙。^666666*呼*^000000 现在我感觉好多了。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Ah, my apologies for not introducing myself earlier.
I am called Annon. You must wondering what I must be doing
here under the ground.
scripts.translation:
[安农]
啊，抱歉刚才没有自我介绍。
我叫安农。你一定很好奇我为什么
会躲在地底下吧。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Well, I'm performing a special exercise for my spiritual training. Though, it may be hard to believe.
scripts.translation:
[安农]
嗯，我正在为我的精神修炼进行一项特殊的训练。虽然这可能很难让人相信。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
What...?
Shuda sent you?! Oh well...
I thank you for curing me. Now, it's time for me to resume my training.
scripts.translation:
[安农]
什么...？
是舒达派你来的？！好吧...
谢谢你治好了我。现在，我该继续我的训练了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, I can't let you go! You don't know how hard it was for me to find you! You can't just leave!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，我不能让你走！我费了好大劲才找到你！你不能就这样离开！

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Hm? Then what is it that you want? I implore you, do not tell Shuda that you have found me. No matter what, I am not going back to her!
scripts.translation:
[安农]
嗯？那你想要什么？我恳求你，不要告诉舒达你找到我了。无论如何，我都不想回到她那里！

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Eh...?
Did you find
her ring already?
Ooh, I was hoping it
would never be found.
scripts.translation:
[安农]
呃...？
你已经找到
她的戒指了吗？
噢，我本来希望
它永远都不要被找到。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
She probably told you that I ran away out of shame for losing the ring, and that if you got the ring back, I'd be happy to return, right?
scripts.translation:
[安农]
她大概告诉你，我是因为弄丢戒指感到羞愧才逃跑的，如果你能找回戒指，我就愿意回去，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Well...
I threw away
that ring on purpose!
I'm serious about not
going back to Shuda.
scripts.translation:
[安农]
嗯...
我是故意扔掉
那枚戒指的！
我是认真的，
我不想回到舒达身边。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
It looks like you wish to know more. If you promise me that you will not mention my whereabouts
to Shuda, then I'll explain.
scripts.translation:
[安农]
看来你想知道更多。如果你答应我，
不把我的行踪告诉舒达，
我就解释给你听。

scripts.text: You think the world revolves around you?
scripts.translation: 你以为世界是围着你转的吗？

scripts.text: What do you want me to do?
scripts.translation: 你想让我做什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You think the world
revolves around you?
You can't just run away!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你以为世界是围着你转的吗？
你不能就这样逃跑！

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Oh, I know, I know!
But you don't understand. Obviously, Shuda is beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[安农]
噢，我知道，我知道！
但你不明白。显然，舒达很美丽。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
But our parents arranged our marriage when we were babies.
That kind of arrangement doesn't matter to me, but she obviously cares about it.
scripts.translation:
[安农]
但我们的父母在我们还是婴儿时就为我们安排了婚事。
这种安排对我无所谓，但她显然很在意。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
In all honesty, she scares me
to death. Whenever I'm with her,
I can't help but break into a cold sweat. And when she's near, I have nightmares about her. ^666666*Brrr...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[安农]
老实说，她让我
吓得要死。每次和她在一起，
我都忍不住冷汗直流。而且当她靠近时，我会做关于她的噩梦。 ^666666*瑟瑟发抖...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Annon]
She thinks it's funny to electrocute me. and ties me up in
a darkened room and feeds me only Jellopy whenever I don't listen to her. Now can you see why I crave freedom?
scripts.translation:
[安农]
她觉得电我很好玩。还会把我绑在
黑暗的房间里，只要我不听话，就只喂我吃杰勒比结晶。现在你能明白我为什么渴望自由了吗？

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Of course, if you reveal to her that you've found me, I'll repay your favor. I implore you, just pretend you haven't found me, please?
scripts.translation:
[安农]
当然，如果你告诉她你找到我了，我会报答你的恩情。我恳求你，假装没找到我，好吗？

scripts.text: ...Alright, alright.
scripts.translation: ...好吧，好吧。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Thank you so much!
Now, to pay you back, let me use one of the skills I've learned in my spiritual training.
scripts.translation:
[安农]
非常感谢！
为了报答你，让我使用一下我在灵性训练中习得的技能。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Of course, what I want you to do is to keep me a secret from Shuda. Just forget that you've ever met me, and let Shuda know it was impossible to find me.
scripts.translation:
[安农]
当然，我想让你做的是对我对舒达保密。就当你从未见过我，并告诉舒达根本不可能找到我。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Besides, even if you help her, all she'll do is offer to name her kids after you. Now... Do you really want that? I know for sure that she and I won't be having children. There's enough evil in the world.
scripts.translation:
[安农]
而且，即使你帮她，她只会提议用你的名字给她的孩子命名。现在...你真的想要那样吗？我确信我和她不会有孩子。世界上已经够邪恶了。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Now, you must be wondering
how I would repay you for your silence. Well, let me show you one of the skills I've learned in my spiritual training.
scripts.translation:
[安农]
现在，你一定在好奇
我会如何报答你的沉默。好吧，让我展示一下我在灵性训练中习得的技能。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Let's see...
Let me twist your
arm this way, and
apply pressure here...
scripts.translation:
[安农]
让我看看...
让我把你的手臂
这样扭一下，
然后在这里施加压力...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wahhh~!
What the hell
are you doing!
You're hurting me, man!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇啊~！
你他妈在干什么！
你弄疼我了，混蛋！

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Oh, this is a special kind
of massage. Don't worry, it'll
relieve you of fatigue. It's quite heavenly, actually. You'll see~
scripts.translation:
[安农]
噢，这是一种特殊的按摩。别担心，它会
消除你的疲劳。其实相当美妙。你会看到的~

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Snap snap snap*
*Snap snap snap*
*Crack crack crack*
*Crack crack crack*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*咔哒 咔哒 咔哒*
*咔哒 咔哒 咔哒*
*咔嚓 咔嚓 咔嚓*
*咔嚓 咔嚓 咔嚓*^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou feel as though Annon
realigned every bone in your skeleton, placing them in the right spots. Strangely, you feel intense relaxation and refreshment instead of excruciating pain.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你感觉安农
重新排列了你骨骼中的每一根骨头，将它们放在正确的位置。奇怪的是，你感到的不是剧烈的疼痛，而是强烈的放松和清爽。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa...?
That felt was so great~
It even feels like my mind
has been cleansed too!
You've got a deal!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...？
感觉太棒了~
感觉连我的心灵
都被净化了！
成交！

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Thank you, thank you so much.
Now I can avoid being tied to Shuda, at least for a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[安农]
谢谢，太感谢了。
这样我就能暂时摆脱舒达的纠缠，
至少能多撑一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Annon]
Now, if you'll excuse me,
I must make good my escape
before others find me.
Good day~!
scripts.translation:
[安农]
那么，失陪了，
我得趁别人发现我之前
赶紧溜走。
再见~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No way, no way.
He's too seriously
wounded to be cured
with the normal potions
that I have. I'll need
a stronger potion...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不行，不行。
他伤得太重了，
我手头的普通药水
治不了他。我需要
一种更强的药水...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, you stay
here for a while.
I'll bring you some
medicine and treat
your wound.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，你先在这里
待一会儿。
我去给你找些药，
然后处理你的伤口。

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
No, you don't have to...
^666666*Cough cough cough*^000000
W-wait, don't push
me back inside!
Wahhhhhh~!
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
不，不用了...
^666666*咳咳咳*^000000
等...等等，别把我
推回去！
哇啊啊啊~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, it's time
for me to play doctor!
I don't have much time!
My mission: Bring back an
ultra powerful potion for
this poor guy~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，是时候
让我大显身手了！
我没多少时间了！
我的任务：为这位
可怜的家伙带回
一种超强力的药水~

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
Annon...?
Who's that?
I've never heard of him!
I don't know him, okay!
Stop disturbing my training!
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
安农...？
那是谁？
我从来没听说过他！
我不认识他，好吗！
别打扰我训练！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh...
Hmm, it doesn't seem like you should be yelling with that kind of wound. You sure you're not Annon?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃...
嗯，你受了那样的伤，
不应该这么大声喊叫。你确定你不是安农？

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
I told you!
I've never
heard of him!
L-leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
我说了！
我从来没
听说过他！
离...离我远点！

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
I have to
hide from Shuda.
^666666*Cries*^000000
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
我必须
躲开舒达。
^666666*哭泣*^000000

scripts.text:
[Haggard Man]
Huh? Who are you?
This isn't a safe place for a tourists! You should leave right away!
scripts.translation:
[憔悴的男子]
咦？你是谁？
这里对游客来说可不是安全的地方！你应该马上离开！

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
This place is known to be
teeming with fish. The fish here tend to eat anything they find,
so it's easy to catch them.
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
这里以鱼群众多而闻名。这里的鱼通常什么都吃，
所以很容易钓到它们。

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
We are providing a fishing rod rental service. Every time you fish, you'll need ^3355FF 1 Monster's Feed^000000 to use as bait, and pay
a rod rental fee of ^3355FF50 Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
我们提供钓竿租赁服务。每次钓鱼，你都需要^3355FF 1 魔物饲料^000000作为诱饵，并支付^3355FF50 Zeny^000000的钓竿租赁费。

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
Would you
like to try?
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
你想
试试吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou cast your
fishing line
into the water.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你将钓线
抛入水中。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou've hooked a Phen!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你钓到了一条剑鱼！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhile cooking the Phen, you
find that it's swallowed a Stone.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在烹饪剑鱼时，你
发现它吞下了一块石头。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFInside of the Phen,
you find a Red Potion.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在剑鱼肚子里，
你发现了一瓶红色药水。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFInside of the Phen,
you find a Yellow Potion.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在剑鱼肚子里，
你发现了一瓶黄色药水。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's nothing inside...
But now you can eat Sushi!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF里面什么都没有...
不过现在你可以吃明虾寿司了！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find
a Flower Ring
inside the Phen.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在剑鱼肚子里
发现了一枚花戒指。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find
a Diamond Ring
inside the Phen.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在剑鱼肚子里
发现了一枚钻石戒指。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a ring
with a name engraved
inside the band.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一枚戒指，
内圈刻着一个名字。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou take the
engagement ring.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你拿起了那枚蓝宝戒指。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
Remember, you need ^3355FF1 Monster's Feed^000000 to use as bait and ^3355FF50 zeny^000000 to rend a rod.
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
记住，你需要^3355FF1个魔物饲料^000000作为鱼饵，以及^3355FF50 Zeny^000000来租用鱼竿。

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
No problem,
come back anytime you
want. Fishing relaxes
the mind and makes you
feel at peace...
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
没问题，
随时欢迎回来。
钓鱼能让人放松身心，
感到平静...

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
The fish here tend
to eat anything they find.
When you gut them, you can
often find interesting things inside.
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
这里的鱼
什么都吃。
处理鱼时，
你经常能在肚子里发现有趣的东西。

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
So when you get a chance,
why don't you sit down, relax
and enjoy some quiet fishing?
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
所以，当你有空的时候，
为什么不坐下来，
放松一下，享受安静的垂钓时光呢？

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
Welcome, long time no see!
It seems people learned that you found some kind of fortune from fishing here. After word got around, I've been getting lots
of customers.
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
欢迎回来，好久不见！
看来人们已经知道在这里钓鱼能发现宝藏了。消息传开后，我的顾客多了不少。

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
I understand that you want
fish, but right now there
aren't any fishing spots
for you at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
我知道你想钓鱼，
但现在暂时没有
适合你的钓点。

scripts.text:
[Dannai]
Please let other
people have their
chance to find their
own fortunes.
scripts.translation:
[丹奈]
请让其他人
也有机会
找到属于他们的宝藏。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou find footprints heading to the ^5C3317North^3355FF. It looks like somebody was in quite a hurry, just like the villager said!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一串通往^5C3317北方^3355FF的脚印。看起来有人很匆忙，就像村民说的那样！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find another set of footprints. It seems that somebody was running away from something. These prints are heading to the ^5C3317East^3355FF. You'd better follow them to see what
you can find.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你又发现了一串脚印。似乎有人在逃离什么。这些脚印通向^5C3317东方^3355FF。你最好跟着看看能发现什么。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe footprints end around this area. Whoever was running must
have been exhausted and stumbled on something. Perhaps the owner of the footprints is nearby...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF脚印在这个区域附近消失了。逃跑的人一定累坏了，还绊到了什么东西。也许脚印的主人就在附近...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you follow the footprints,
you arrive at the '^5C3317Entrance of the Shrine^3355FF.' Whoever this person was, he just ran into the second level.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF顺着脚印，
你来到了'^5C3317神龛入口^3355FF'。不管这个人是谁，他刚跑进了第二层。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find the same footprints
in this place. It seems pretty
dangerous, and you wonder why
anyone would come here. The
footprints continue towards
the ^5C3317North^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在这里发现了同样的脚印。
这里看起来很危险，
你想知道为什么会有人来这里。
脚印继续通向^5C3317北方^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe trail of footprints
continue here, and seem
to look more freshly made.^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里的脚印
还在继续，
而且看起来是刚留下的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHmm...?
There's something here...^000000
Ignore.
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text: ^5C3317Investigate.^000000

[{0}]
Well, it's probably nothing. But which way should I go now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，可能没什么大事。但我现在该往哪边走呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why, this is a pack of White Potions. Whoever owned these must have dropped these by accident. Hmm, I could use these for later...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦，这是一包白色药水。主人一定是不小心掉在这里的。嗯，我可以留着以后用...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait...
There are more
footprints heading
toward the ^5C3317East^000000.
I better look
into this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...
还有更多的脚印
通向^5C3317东方^000000。
我最好去调查一下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why, this is a pack of Yellow Potions. Whoever owned these must have dropped these by accident. Hmm, I could use these for later...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦，这是一包黄色药水。主人一定是不小心掉在这里的。嗯，我可以留着以后用...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait...
There are more
footprints heading
toward the ^5C3317East^000000.
I better look
into this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...
还有更多的脚印
通向^5C3317东方^000000。
我最好去调查一下。

^FF0000Squeak!
^FF0000Squeak Squeak!^000000

[{0}]
^8C1717Wah^000000!
What was that?!

^3355FFIt was just a rat.
It feels awful silly to be scared by just a little rat, does it not?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF只是一只老鼠而已。
被一只小老鼠吓到，感觉挺傻的，不是吗？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find another trail
of footprints that heads
towards the ^5C3317East^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现另一串脚印，
通向^5C3317东方^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhere is he...?
He seems to have gone
deep into the dungeon.
Just looking for this
guy is exhausting...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF他在哪里...？
他似乎深入了迷宫。
光是找这个人就让人精疲力竭...^000000

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Weird...
Why was that guy
running into the
shrine like that?
That really
bothers me...
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
奇怪...
那个人为什么
会那样跑进
神龛里？
这真的
让我很在意...

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Oh, aren't you
from Midgard?
Hello there~
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
哦，你是
来自米德加尔特的人吗？
你好呀~

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Ah...
You heard me talking to myself? Well, I didn't see who he was but, some guy ran into the forest which leads to the shrine. He seemed really terrified of something.
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
啊...
你听到我自说自话了？好吧，我没看清他是谁，但有个人跑进了通往神龛的普勒斯特森林。他看起来非常害怕什么东西。

scripts.text:
[Tham]
He came from out of nowhere, so he scared the crap out of me. Do you think he could be a criminal?
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
他突然出现，把我吓得半死。你觉得他可能是个罪犯吗？

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Ah! I think, in his intense fear, he was screaming something about some kind of '^FF0000Shuda^000000,' or whatever. But what could it possibly mean?
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
啊！我想，他在极度恐惧中，好像在大声喊着什么“^FF0000舒达^000000”之类的。但那到底是什么意思呢？

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Oh well, don't worry. All of our villagers aren't like that. Anyway, I hope you enjoy your travels in Ayothaya.
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
算了，别担心。我们村里的村民不都是那样的。总之，祝你在哎哟泰雅旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Oh hello~
I can tell from your clothes that you must be from Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
哦，你好~
看你的穿着，你一定是来自米德加尔特的人。

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Recently, it seems that
our village has been receiving
more tourism, and I can see that
our village is being influenced
in a positive way.
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
最近，似乎
我们村庄接待了
更多的游客，我能感觉到
我们的村庄正在
受到积极的影响。

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Ah...
While you're here,
why don't you taste some
authentic Ayothaya cuisine
for yourself?
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
啊...
既然你在这里，
何不亲自尝尝
正宗的哎哟泰雅美食呢？

scripts.text:
[Tham]
We're known for our
spicy and sweet seafood,
and there are some nice
restaurants around here.
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
我们以
辛辣甜美的海鲜闻名，
这里附近
有一些不错的
餐厅。

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Anyway, I'm sure that you'll like it. I hope that you come visit Ayothaya as often as you can~
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
总之，我相信你一定会喜欢的。希望你能尽可能常来哎哟泰雅做客~

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Ah~
I've got this craving for Ms. Mali the Spicy's food, especially her 'Tom Yum Goong.'
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
啊~
我突然很想念辣妹 玛丽做的菜，尤其是她的“泰式BBQ”。

scripts.text:
[Tham]
I think it's the
most delicious dish
in the entire world!
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
我觉得那是
世界上最美味的一道菜！

scripts.text:
[Tham]
Oh hello~
I can tell from your clothes that you must be from Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
哦，你好~
看你的穿着，你一定是来自米德加尔特的人。

scripts.text:
[Tham]
I hope that you enjoy your stay here, and that you come visit Ayothaya as often as you can~
scripts.translation:
[坦姆]
希望你在我们这里住得愉快，
也希望能尽可能常来哎哟泰雅做客~

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
Oh...!
You must be a traveller.
I have a tale you may wish to hear if you're interested in listening.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
哦...！
你一定是位旅行者吧。
如果你有兴趣听的话，我有一个故事想讲给你听。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什么事？

scripts.text: I know what the story is.
scripts.translation: 我知道这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
Ayothaya has a long history. Perhaps it looks calm and peaceful now, but in the past our village was terrorized by a terrible creature.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
哎哟泰雅有着悠久的历史。虽然现在看起来平静祥和，但在过去，我们的村庄曾被一种可怕的生物所 terrorized。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
This beast is known to us as
the ^660000Sa-mhing Tiger^000000, which used
to dwell deep in the ancient ruins.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
这种生物被称为
^660000萨姆亨虎^000000，它曾栖息在古老的遗迹深处。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
The Sa-mhing Tiger is addicted
to the taste of human flesh. It has been known to transform into the shape of a person it has eaten in order to lure out his family and friends.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
萨姆亨虎沉迷于人类肉体的味道。它曾化身为它所吃掉的人的模样，以此引诱其家人和朋友。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
The local people are still afraid that the creature might transform into someone they know, and sneak into their homes to eat them.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
当地人仍然害怕这种生物会化身为他们认识的人，潜入家中将他们吃掉。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
However, there is one way you can identify the Sa-mhing Tiger from a human being. Since it's a tiger, it cannot do some of the things
humans are taught to do,
such as light a match.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
不过，有一种方法可以分辨萨姆亨虎和人类。因为它本质上是老虎，所以它无法做到一些人类学会的事情，比如划火柴。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
So, if by any chance you see
a friend acting strangely all
of a sudden, ask him to strike
a match. Make sure he is not
the Sa-mhing Tiger.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
所以，如果你偶然看到朋友突然行为怪异，就让他划一根火柴。确认他不是萨姆亨虎。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
However...
I'm not sure if this actually works or not. I guess the best thing to do is just run for your life if you even suspect someone of being
the Sa-mhing Tiger.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
但是...
我不确定这招是否真的有效。我想最好的办法是，一旦怀疑某人是萨姆亨虎，就拼命逃跑。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
Do you believe
in the existance
of man-eating tigers?
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
你相信
食人虎的存在吗？

scripts.text: Well, not really.
scripts.translation: 嗯，不太相信。

scripts.text: Yes, I do and I think they're scary!
scripts.translation: 相信，我觉得它们很可怕！

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
Umm...
Oh well. My late grandfather told me about the Sa-mhing Tiger when
I was a little kid. Of course,
I haven't seen it.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
嗯...
算了。我小时候，已故的祖父曾给我讲过萨姆亨虎的故事。当然，我并没有亲眼见过它。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
The closest thing I've seen to the Sa-mhing Tiger was a golden cat with a bell. Somehow, I don't think it ate men.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
我见过最接近萨姆亨虎的东西，是一只戴着铃铛的金猫。不过，我不觉得它会吃人。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
Run for your life if you ever encounter the Sa-mhing Tiger!
It'll eat you alive!
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
如果你遇到萨姆亨虎，请拼命逃跑！
它会把你活活吃掉的！

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
If you're interested in finding
out more about the story, I can introduce you to someone who
knows that creature more than
anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
如果你有兴趣了解更多关于这个故事的内容，我可以介绍你认识一个人，他比任何人都更了解那种生物。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
Why don't you talk to Boonthom? He's a pretty strange person, but there's something about him...
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
你为什么不和本通谈谈呢？他是个挺奇怪的人，但他身上有种...说不清的感觉。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
Ah well, you'll see what I'm talking about. I hope he'll help you learn more about that evil creature.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
算了，你亲自去看看吧。希望他能帮你了解更多关于那个邪恶生物的事情。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
You do now?
Then be careful!
It'll eat you alive!
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
你现在知道了？
那一定要小心！
它会把你活活吃掉的！

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
How are you?
If you're interested
in the Sa-mhing Tiger,
please go talk to Boonthom.
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
你好吗？
如果你对萨姆亨虎感兴趣，
请去和本通谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Dusit]
But beware!
The Sa-mhing Tiger might be
closer to you than you expect!
scripts.translation:
[杜西特]
但请小心！
萨姆亨虎可能比你想象的离你更近！

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
You...!
Isn't it....!
Oooooohhhhhhh!
scripts.translation:
[本通]
你...！
难道不是....！
噢噢噢噢噢！

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Oh...?

[Boonthom]
...

[Boonthom]
...
......

[Boonthom]
Never mind.
Hah! I've lost my
train of thought.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
算了。
哈哈！我刚才走神了。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
So have you come to me to seek help? I can see the fear in your eyes. Let me gaze into your soul, and see what your fear is for myself. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[本通]
所以你是来向我求助的吗？我能看到你眼中的恐惧。让我凝视你的灵魂，看看你究竟在害怕什么。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
...

[Boonthom]
...
......

[Boonthom]
What...!
I see that you dread the Sa-mhing Tiger! I haven't heard any news of that monster for a long time...
scripts.translation:
[本通]
什么...！
原来你害怕的是萨姆亨虎！我已经很久没有听到关于那个魔物的消息了...

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
A long time ago,
the Sa-mhing Tiger
really did roam the village
and ate innocent people.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
很久以前，
萨姆亨虎确实曾在村庄里游荡，
并吞噬无辜的村民。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
However, its terror
was brought to an end when it
was finally captured. I was one of those involved in capturing the Sa-mhing Tiger.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
不过，它的恐怖统治终于结束了，因为它被捕获了。我是参与捕获萨姆亨虎的人之一。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
I insisted killing on it, but the other people were too afraid to do so. Instead, the Sa-mhing Tiger
was locked in a cave inside of the ancient ruins.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
我坚持要杀掉它，但其他人太害怕了，不敢动手。于是，萨姆亨虎被锁在了古代遗迹里的一个洞穴中。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
I believe that was at least 10 years ago. Perhaps it's already dead by now. However, no one
knows how powerful the tiger truly
is. It may still be alive.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
我想那至少是10年前的事了。也许它现在已经死了。但是，没人知道这只老虎究竟有多强大。它可能还活着。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
I don't think we need to worry about it though. It is locked up and there it shall remain.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
不过我觉得我们不需要担心。它被锁起来了，而且会一直留在那里。

scripts.text: I want to explore the ancient ruins.
scripts.translation: 我想探索古代遗迹。

scripts.text: Locked up! Good! I'm not afraid!
scripts.translation: 锁起来了！很好！我不怕！

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
You...
You are strange.
You want to explore the ancient ruins. Do all adventurers disregard their safety like that?
scripts.translation:
[本通]
你...
真奇怪。
你想探索古代遗迹。难道所有冒险者都不顾自身安危吗？

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
It's your choice. But remember, it is very dangerous to go through the path to the center of the building. Usually, I forbid it.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
这是你的选择。但请记住，通往建筑中心的路非常危险。通常，我是禁止通行的。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
But if you want to go in,
I can give you some useful tips.
Would you like to listen?
scripts.translation:
[本通]
但如果你执意要进去，
我可以给你一些有用的建议。
你想听听吗？

scripts.text: If it's that dangerous, I'd rather not try.
scripts.translation: 既然那么危险，我还是不去了。

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
You made a good decision.
You'd better be careful if
you want to stay alive.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
你做了一个明智的决定。
如果你想活着，最好小心点。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Umm, okay.
Since you're
that interested...
scripts.translation:
[本通]
嗯，好吧。
既然你那么感兴趣...

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
If you wish to enter the ancient building, you must have protection against evil spirits and malice.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
如果你想进入这座古建筑，你必须拥有对抗邪灵和恶意的手段。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Even if you can
wield the power of
holiness, you will still need the spiritual security of our land.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
即使你能
运用神圣的力量，
你仍然需要这片土地的精神庇护。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
There are many ghosts and
demons within the cave, and they will attack people who do not possess holy power... Like you.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
洞穴里有许多幽灵和恶魔，它们会攻击没有神圣力量的人...比如你。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
I can make you an object
containing this holy power if you wish. In order to make it, I will need some materials.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
如果你愿意，
我可以为你制作一件蕴含这种神圣力量的物品。为了制作它，我需要一些材料。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Please come back
when you prepare all
the materials.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
请准备好所有材料后
再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Hmmm...
Not afraid
of it, are you?
scripts.translation:
[本通]
嗯...
你并不害怕，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Excellent!
Now you have brought
everything I need. Let me make
the thing for you as promised...
scripts.translation:
[本通]
太好了！
现在你已经带来了
我需要的东西。让我按承诺为你制作吧...

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Ooooohmmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[本通]
噢噢噢姆姆姆...

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Hmmmmmm...
Hmmmmmmmmm.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
嗯嗯嗯嗯...
嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Pffff pffff...
scripts.translation:
[本通]
噗噗 噗噗...

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Here you go.
Please take these holy threads.
With this, you will be able to enter the ruins with less worry.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
给你。
请收下这些神圣线纱。
有了它，你进入遗迹时就会少些担忧。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Even if you lose this, don't worry. Just bring me the materials, and
I will make you another one.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
即使弄丢了也不用担心。
只要把材料带给我，
我就能再为你制作一个。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
The ancient building consists
of 2 levels. Before you enter the 2nd underground level, please return to me so that I can tell you how to enter that place.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
这座古代建筑共有两层。
在进入第二层地下之前，请先回到我这里，
我会告诉你如何进入那个地方。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Did you forget what materials
you need to create my object of holy power? Please listen
carefully this time.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
你忘记制作我的圣力神器需要什么材料了吗？
这次请仔细听好。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
See you later.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
回头见。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Excellent! Now you have brought everything I need, let me make the thing for you as I promised...
scripts.translation:
[本通]
太好了！
既然你已经带来了所有我需要的东西，
让我按承诺为你制作吧...

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Ooooohmmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[本通]
噢噢噢姆姆姆...

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Hmmmmmm...
Hmmmmmmmmm.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
嗯嗯嗯嗯...
嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Pffff pffff...
scripts.translation:
[本通]
噗噗 噗噗...

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Here you go.
Please take these holy threads.
With this, you will be able to enter the ruins with less worry.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
给你。
请收下这些神圣线纱。
有了它，你进入遗迹时就会少些担忧。

scripts.text:
[Boonthom]
Even if you lose this, don't worry. Just bring me the materials, I can make you another one.
scripts.translation:
[本通]
即使弄丢了也不用担心。

note, the 2nd underground level is very very dangerous. You will need holy threads that contain even more holy protection.

即使没有萨姆亨虎，

[Puraim]

say, 'curiousity killed the cat.'
Anyway, go for it!
scripts.translation:
[普莱姆]

所说，“好奇心害死猫”。
总之，去吧！

smart enough not to
stupidly jeopardize your life.

[普莱姆]

不会愚蠢地拿自己的性命去冒险。

[Old Letter]
^333333Dear, Boonthom,
I was a fool. There is 'Sa-mhing Tig'...One who ....my remains... Please take...to Boonthom...
scripts.translation:
[旧信]
^333333亲爱的本通：
我是个傻瓜。那里有“萨姆辛·蒂格”...一个...我的遗骸...请带...给本通...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou pick
up the box.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你捡起了那个盒子。^000000

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Do you know what the
most popular cuisine
of this village is?
scripts.translation:
[艾农]
你知道这个村庄最受欢迎的料理是什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Ayothaya is world famous
for its regional cuisine, but
out of all Ayothayan dishes,
'^3131FFTom Yum Goong^000000' is the best.
scripts.translation:
[艾农]
哎哟泰雅以地方美食闻名于世，但在所有哎哟泰雅菜肴中，'^3131FF泰式BBQ^000000'是最棒的。

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Tom Yum Goong is a type
of soup that is very spicy. Try it once, and you will be amazed by its profound taste. Try it twice, and you will be enraptured by its tantalizing aroma.
scripts.translation:
[艾农]
泰式BBQ是一种非常辣的汤。尝一次，你会被它深邃的味道所惊叹；尝两次，你会被它诱人的香气所迷住。

scripts.text:
[Einon]
It's really one of the most delicious foods in the world!
Everyone in the world would
want to try this at least once in his lifetime. So, would you like
to try some?
scripts.translation:
[艾农]
它真的是世界上最美味的食物之一！
世界上每个人都想至少尝一次。那么，你想尝尝吗？

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text: No, thanks. I hate spicy food.
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢。我不吃辣。

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Okay...!
Now who would be
best for preparing
Tom Yum Goong for you?
Hmmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[艾农]
好的...！
那么，谁最适合为您准备泰式BBQ呢？
嗯......

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Everyone in the village
knows how to make it, but
I recommend that you go
visit ^3131FFMali the Spicy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾农]
村里的人都会做，但我建议您去拜访^3131FF辣妹 玛丽^000000。

scripts.text:
[Einon]
She is the best cook when it
comes to Tom Yum Goong!
Why don't you ask her
to cook you some?
scripts.translation:
[艾农]
她是做泰式BBQ最厉害的厨师！
您何不请她为您做一份呢？

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Oh I see...
However, when you
change your mind,
please come back.
scripts.translation:
[艾农]
哦，我明白了...
不过，如果您改变主意了，
请回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Ah, you wanna know
where ^3131FFMali the Spicy^000000 is?
Well, there's not too many places
a cook would stay other than in
a restaurant, right? Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[艾农]
啊，您想知道^3131FF辣妹 玛丽^000000在哪里吗？
嗯，除了餐厅，厨师还能待在哪里呢，对吧？哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Einon]
Golden Ayothaya...
Although I've grown
up in this village,
I still think my village
is magnificient and beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[艾农]
金色的哎哟泰雅...
虽然我就出生在这个村庄，
但我依然觉得我的村庄
壮丽而美丽。

scripts.text:
[Einon]
What do you think?
Wouldn't you agree with me?
scripts.translation:
[艾农]
您觉得呢？
您不会同意我的看法吗？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Hello, there!
I am called Mali the Spicy.
All of my dishes always amaze
my customers with their tempting scents and deep flavors.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
你好呀！
我叫辣妹 玛丽。
我的每一道菜都能以其诱人的香气和浓郁的味道
让顾客们惊叹不已。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I am especially proud of my
^3131FFTom Yum Goong^000000, which is the
best in the village. I suppose
it's my fate to cook the greatest Tom Yum Goong ever.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
我尤其以我的^3131FF泰式BBQ^000000为荣，它是村里最好的。我想，
烹饪出史上最棒的泰式BBQ就是我的命运吧。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Oh I see...
You want me to cook
Tom Yum Goong for you,
don't you?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
哦，我明白了...
您是想让我为您做一份泰式BBQ，
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Honestly, I've been really
busy ever since I opened this restaurant. If you really wish to taste my Tom Yum Goong, would
you do something for me?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
说实话，自从开了这家餐厅以来，我一直很忙。如果您真的想品尝我的泰式BBQ，您愿意为我做件事吗？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text: Eh... I dunno.
scripts.translation: 呃...我不知道。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
First, would you get
the ingredients to make
Tom Yum Goong for me? I'll need some ^CE0000Shrimps^000000, ^CE0000Chiles^000000 and ^CE0000Lemons^000000.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
首先，您能帮我弄到做泰式BBQ的食材吗？我需要一些^CE0000虾^000000、^CE0000辣椒^000000和^CE0000柠檬^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Remember, Shrimp is the main ingredient of this dish. So, the fresher the Shrimp, the tastier your food will be.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
记住，虾是这道菜的主料。所以，虾越新鲜，食物就越美味。

scripts.text: Where can I find them?
scripts.translation: 我在哪里能找到它们？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I expected you
to ask me that.
For Shrimps, look around
the beach. You should see
a lot of them there.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
我就知道您会问这个。
至于虾，去海滩周围找找看。您应该能看到很多。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
However, you might have a hard time finding them since you haven't done that before. So just buy some Shrimp from the guy who sells
the freshest Shrimp around.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
不过，由于您以前没做过，可能会很难找到。所以，您可以直接从卖最新鲜虾的那个人那里买一些。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Hmmm...
If you mention
my name, that guy
might give you a discount.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
嗯...
如果您提到我的名字，那个人
可能会给您打折。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
His name is ^3131FFThongpool^000000.
He will be somewhere around the village selling Shrimps. Go and ask him to give you 20 Shrimps to cook Tom Yum Goong.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
他叫^3131FF通普^000000。
他会在村庄附近卖虾。去请他给您20只虾来做泰式BBQ吧。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I understand this might be difficult to do, but it's worth
a try if you really want to taste the best Tom Yum Goong.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
我知道这可能有点难，但如果您真的想品尝最好的泰式BBQ，值得一试。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Errr...
What's wrong with these Shrimp?
They all have these scratches and rips in them! I can't believe Thongpool sold such bad Shrimp
to his customers!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
哎呀...
这些虾怎么回事？
它们身上全是划痕和破口！真不敢相信通普会把这么差的虾卖给顾客！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I'm so sorry, but
I can't cook the best
Tom Yum Goong with
these Shrimp.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
非常抱歉，
用这些虾
我没法做出
最好的泰式BBQ。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I know it's an inconvenience, but would you go back to Thongpool
and ask him to give you the freshest Shrimp to cook the best
Tom Yum Goong?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
我知道这给您添麻烦了，但您能回到通普那里，
请他给您最新鲜的虾，
以便我做出最好的泰式BBQ吗？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Ah, you came back!
Now, let me see what
you've brought. Hmm...
These are...
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
啊，您回来了！
让我看看您带了什么。嗯...
这些是...

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
The freshest Shrimp that
I've been looking for! Well done~
With these big and fresh Shrimp,
I can cook the best Tom Yum Goong for you! Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
正是我寻找的最新鲜的虾！做得好~
有了这些又大又新鲜的虾，
我就能为您做出最好的泰式BBQ了！太感谢您了！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
It will be a perfect food with the natural sweetness of the Shrimp, the sourness of Lemons and a little bit of fish sauce!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
这将是一道完美的料理，拥有虾的天然甜味、柠檬的酸味，还有一点点鱼露的鲜味！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Oh... Right.
But we only have Shrimp.
Now, I want you to bring
me some ^CE0000Lemons^000000.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
哦...对了。
但我们现在只有虾。
现在，请您去给我带一些^CE0000柠檬^000000。

scripts.text: Where can I find Lemons?
scripts.translation: 我在哪里能找到柠檬？

scripts.text: I hate sour food. I'd better quit!
scripts.translation: 我讨厌酸的食物。我还是放弃吧！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
A few days ago, I saw a good
Lemon tree while taking a walk.
But this tree belongs to an ordinary man who's not a Fruit Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
几天前，我散步时看到了一棵很好的柠檬树。
但这棵树属于一个普通男子，他并不是水果商人。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I'm not sure whether
or not he'd sell Lemons
to you, but you can try,
I guess.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
我不确定他
会不会把柠檬
卖给您，但您可以试试，
我想。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
What a stupid...!
If you quit just because you really hate sour flavors, you must not be that eager to have my Tom Yum Goong!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
真笨...！
如果您仅仅因为讨厌酸味就放弃，那您一定不是真的想品尝我的泰式BBQ！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Once you taste my
Tom Yum Goong, you'll
regret what you just said!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
一旦您尝到我的
泰式BBQ，您就会
后悔刚才说的话！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Huh...?
What did you do
with the Shrimps?
You didn't eat them
on the way here, did you?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
嗯...？
您把虾怎么了？
您不会在半路上
把它们吃了吧？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Make sure you ask
Mr. Thongpool to give
you 20 Shrimps.
Now hurry~
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
一定要请通普先生
给您20只虾。
现在快去吧~

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
You think these are
the best quality Lemons?
Take a closer look!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
您觉得这些是
质量最好的柠檬？
仔细看看！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
The skin of these
Lemons lack luster
and they don't even smell
fresh! They're just
common Lemons!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
这些柠檬的表皮
缺乏光泽，
甚至闻起来都不新鲜！它们只是
普通的柠檬！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Welcome back!
Wow, you came back
really fast! Okay, let me
see the Lemons
you brought?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
欢迎回来！
哇，您回来得真快！好的，让我
看看您带的柠檬？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Wow, great!
These are really fresh Lemons!
How could you bring all of these by yourself? Thanks for your trouble~
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
哇，太棒了！
这些真是新鲜的柠檬！
您是怎么一个人带这么多来的？谢谢您的辛苦~

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Now, you should go buy
some ^CE0000Chiles^000000 and some
other materials in the Market.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
现在，您应该去市场买一些^CE0000辣椒^000000和其他材料。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
When you talk
to the Merchants
in the Market, they
will know what you want.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
当您与市场里的商人交谈时，
他们会知道您想要什么。

scripts.text: Okay, I'll be right back.
scripts.translation: 好的，我马上回来。

scripts.text: Ah, I'm tired now. Let me take a rest first...
scripts.translation: 啊，我现在累了。让我先休息一下...

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
See you in a bit~
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
一会儿见~

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
It's your call.
But remember...
The Shrimps might go bad
while you're taking a rest.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
随您便。
但请记住...
您休息的时候，
虾可能会变质的。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Huh...?
What did you
do with Lemons?
You didn't eat them
all on the way here, did you?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
嗯...？
你对柠檬做了什么？
你难道在来的路上
把它们全吃光了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Alright...
I'm counting on you
to get the best Lemons
from the guy that owns that tree.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
好吧...
我指望你从那个
拥有那棵树的人那里
买到最好的柠檬。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Somehow, you've got
to get those high quality
Lemons so that I can make
some Tom Yum Goong!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
总之，
你必须弄到那些高品质的柠檬，
这样我才能做泰式BBQ！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I don't understand...
Where did you get these
bad ingredients?! Didn't
I tell you that my
Tom Yum Goong
requires the best?!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
我不明白...
你从哪弄来这些
劣质食材的？！我不是说过
我的泰式BBQ
需要最好的吗？！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
I know you've been working hard to do me this favor. I hope you'll put forth that last little bit of effort to finish this.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
我知道你为了帮我这个忙很努力。我希望你能再坚持一下，完成这件事。

scripts.text:
[Malli the Spicy]
Please go take a look in the Market. I don't doubt that it will be a good experience. After all, my fantastic Tom Yum Goong is waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
请去市场看看吧。我相信这会是一次很好的体验。毕竟，我美味的泰式BBQ在等着你！

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Now...
Everything is all set!
Before we start, let me
check the materials.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
现在...
一切都准备好了！
开始之前，让我
检查一下材料。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
^CE0000Shrimp^000000, ^CE0000Chiles^000000, ^CE0000Lemons^000000...
Fish sauce and other little things...

[Mali the Spicy]
Perfect!
Shall we begin?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
完美！
我们开始吧？

scripts.text:
^FF0031*Chop chop*^000000
^FF9C00*Tup tup tup*^000000
^639CFF*Pu pu^000000 -

[Mali the Spicy]
- ^9C6300Tup tup^000000 ^006363chook^000000
^316363Chop chop^000000
^FF0000Tup tup tup^000000 ^009C00Pu pu^000000 -

[Mali the Spicy]
Wah^00009Cah^0000FFahhhh^0063FFaaaahhh^000000!

[Mali the Spicy]
Here's your
Tom Yum Goong!
Ah~ This taste,
this scent... Yeah.
I know I did a good job.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
这是您的泰式BBQ！
啊~ 这个味道，
这个香气... 没错。
我知道我做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Do you know what is the secret of Tom Yum Goong? It isn't simply just food. This has the power to heal you, and help you get into better shape.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
你知道泰式BBQ的秘密吗？它不仅仅是食物。它拥有治愈的力量，还能帮助你恢复体力。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Because...
It contains the
power of God.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
因为...
它蕴含着
神的力量。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Okay...!
I'm giving you
10 Tom Yum Goong
free of charge~
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
好...！
我免费送你
10份泰式BBQ~

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Thank you for all the trouble that you have been though to get these ingredients. It would make me happy if you shared Tom Yum Goong with your friends.
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
谢谢你辛苦收集这些食材。如果你能和朋友们分享泰式BBQ，我会很高兴的。

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Share the flavor of Ayothaya, and let them know how beautiful our land is. It was good to see you, take care now~
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
分享哎哟泰雅的美味，让他们知道我们的土地有多美丽。很高兴见到你，再见~

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Huh? What did you do with the Chiles? You didn't eat them all on the way here, did you?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
咦？辣椒呢？你难道在来的路上把它们都吃光了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Hmm...
You seem to be carrying too many things. Why don't you free up some space in your inventory first, and then come back?
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
嗯...
你好像携带了太多东西。为什么不先清理一下背包空间，然后再回来呢？

scripts.text:
[Mali the Spicy]
Ah...!
So busy, so busy!
My customers never get tired of
the taste of my Tom Yum Goong!
Heh heh heh~!
scripts.translation:
[辣妹 玛丽]
啊...！
好忙，好忙！
我的顾客们永远吃不腻
我的泰式BBQ！
嘿嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please enlighten your weight -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！ -
- 你目前携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请减轻负重 -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Come adventurers,
take a look! I have
plenty of Shrimp!
scripts.translation:
[通普]
冒险者们，
来看看！我有
很多虾！

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
You're looking for Shrimp,
aren't you? How many Shrimp
do you need? Twenty? Forty?
scripts.translation:
[通普]
你在找虾，
对吧？你需要多少虾？
二十只？四十只？

scripts.text: I need Shrimp for Tom Yum Goong.
scripts.translation: 我需要虾来做泰式BBQ。

scripts.text: Err, they look expensive.
scripts.translation: 呃，它们看起来很贵。

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Ah! I guess Ms. Mali the Spicy recommended me to you. I guess
that also means you want to buy them in bulk?
scripts.translation:
[通普]
啊！我想是辣妹 玛丽推荐你来的吧。那也就是说你想批量购买？

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
After all,
you'll need a larger
amount of Shrimp to
cook Tom Yum Goong.
scripts.translation:
[通普]
毕竟，
要做泰式BBQ，
你需要大量的虾。

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Oh yes, you will need 20 Shrimps for Ms. Mali's Tom Yum Goong.
I'll even give you a discount:
11,000 zeny for 20 shrimps.
What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[通普]
没错，辣妹 玛丽的泰式BBQ需要20只虾。
我甚至可以给你打折：
20只虾只要11,000 Zeny。
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: I will take them.
scripts.translation: 我要买。

scripts.text: I could get 100 Jellopies for that much!
scripts.translation: 这点钱能买100个果冻派！

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Good, now you have the

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Awww...
You don't have
enough money.
scripts.translation:
[通普]
哎呀...
你的钱不够。

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Well well well...
You might fill your hungry stomach with that many Jellopies but they wouldn't taste as good as my Shrimp!
scripts.translation:
[通普]
哎呀哎呀...
虽然你可以用那么多果冻派填饱肚子，但它们可没有我的虾好吃！

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
What...?
Do you think
it's expensive?
But the fantastic taste
of Tom Yum Goong
is priceless!
scripts.translation:
[通普]
什么...？
你觉得贵吗？
但泰式BBQ那绝妙的味道是无价的！

scripts.text:
[Thongpool]
Mmm...?
Did you need
more Shrimps?
Would you like
to buy more?
scripts.translation:
[通普]
嗯...？
你需要更多虾吗？
要再买一些吗？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 准备好了！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:

There you go~
The freshest Shrimp you can ever get in this village, and maybe even the world!

给你~
这是这个村庄，甚至可能是全世界最新鲜的虾！

[Thongpool]
Welcome, welcome!
I've got the best Shrimp caught in the cleanest waters in the world~!
scripts.translation:
[通普]
欢迎，欢迎！
我有在世界上最清澈的水域捕获的最棒的虾~！

more Lemons

scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
嗯...？
你不需要更多柠檬
了吧？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Give me Lemons, old man!
scripts.translation: 给我柠檬，老头！

scripts.text: Can I have some more Lemons, please?
scripts.translation: 能再给我一些柠檬吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Then why don't you taste
the Lemons I gave you last time? They're really sour, but also very delicious!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
那你为什么不去尝尝我上次给你的柠檬呢？它们真的很酸，但也非常美味！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
What...!?
What's wrong with you, kid?
What have you done with the
Lemons I gave you last time?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
什么...！？
你怎么了，小孩？
我上次给你的柠檬你拿去干什么了？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Oh, I am sorry....recently my lemon storage
was attacked by ^3131FF'Leaf Cats'^000000 that are roaming around the Shrine.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
哦，对不起....最近我的柠檬仓库
被在神龛附近游荡的^3131FF群叶猫^000000袭击了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
I wish that I could help you,
but I don't even have enough lemons for my business.
If you need lemons, why don't you go hunt them?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
我很想帮你，
但我连做生意用的柠檬都不够。
如果你需要柠檬，为什么不去猎取一些呢？

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]

some help...?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]

你需要
什么帮助...？

scripts.text: I need some Lemons.
scripts.translation: 我需要一些柠檬。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Umm...
Lemons?
As you see, I have plenty
of Lemons on my tree.
Do you really need some?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
嗯...
柠檬？
你看，我的树上有很多柠檬。
你真的需要一些吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I will pay you.
scripts.translation: 是的，我会付钱给你。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
I started growing this Lemon tree as a hobby, but I didn't expect to have such a good harvest of sweet,
succulent Lemons.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
我种这棵柠檬树只是作为爱好，但我没想到能收获这么多甜美多汁的柠檬。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Did you just say you were
going to pay me for the Lemons?
Oh, you've got me wrong. I don't intend to sell these.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
你刚才说是要付钱买柠檬吗？
哎呀，你误会了。我可没打算卖这些。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
But...
I'm more than willing
to share some of them with
you, but only if you can...
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
不过...
我非常乐意分一些给你，
但前提是你能...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Play a small game with me!
How about that? I've been so bored to death. Even an old man like me needs to enjoy himself!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
陪我玩个小游戏！
怎么样？我都无聊死了。像我这样的老人也需要尽兴一下！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Hahahaha~!
What do you say?
Would you like to try?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
哈哈哈哈哈~！
你觉得如何？
想试试吗？

scripts.text: Sure, why not!
scripts.translation: 好啊，为什么不呢！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Good!
The game I want us
to play is an easy
children's game.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
很好！
我想玩的游戏是个
简单的儿童游戏。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
^660000Rock,
Paper, Scissors!^000000
Perhaps you've heard
of it in your land.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
^660000石头、
剪刀、布！^000000
也许你在你的家乡
听说过它。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Nuh-uh, don't look at me like that. I'm an old man, and I want to play this game and re-live my youth
a little bit. You'll understand when you're my age.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
别那样看着我。我是个老人，我想玩这个游戏，重温一下青春。
等你到了我这个年纪就会明白了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Alright, if you win
^3131FF3^000000 out of ^3131FF5^000000 matches,
The Lemons are yours.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
好了，如果你赢
^3131FF3^000000 局中的 ^3131FF5^000000 局，
柠檬就是你的了。
准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Okay...
As you kids say,
^990000Let's get eXtreme!^000000
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
好吧...
就像你们年轻人说的，
^990000让我们尽情狂欢吧！^000000

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Rock!
Paper!
Scissors!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
石头！
剪刀！
布！

scripts.text: Scissors
scripts.translation: 剪刀

scripts.text: Rock
scripts.translation: 石头

scripts.text: Paper

Rock! Paper!
Scissors!
scripts.translation:

哼。
平局。

石头！剪刀！
布！

Oh my God, yes!
scripts.translation:

天哪，是的！

scripts.translation:

不...！
大逆不道！

布！

哇哈哈哈哈哈！
你输了，小孩！

scripts.text:

Heh heh~
Young fool!
scripts.translation:

嘿嘿~
愚蠢的年轻人！

Noooo...!
This cannot be!

不...！
这不可能！

Rock! Paper!
Scissors!
scripts.translation:

石头！剪刀！
布！

scripts.text:

You... won.
I'm so exhausted.
I guess I can't compete
with you youngsters
anymore. Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
你...赢了。
我累坏了。
看来我跟你们年轻人
比不了了。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
As promised,
I shall share some
of my Lemons with you.
Grab as many as you want!
^3355FFYou have plucked
10 Lemons from the tree.^000000
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
如我所愿，
我会分一些
我的柠檬给你。
想拿多少就拿多少！
^3355FF你从树上摘了
10个柠檬。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Hmm...
Looks like you need a lot of them. Oh well, that's fine with me. I had a good time with you.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
嗯...
看来你需要很多。好吧，这对我来说没问题。和你在一起我很开心。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Don't forget this though:
Don't be selfish, and always share what you have with others. That's one of the most important values for human beings.
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
不过别忘了：
不要自私，要总是与他人分享你拥有的东西。这是人类最重要的价值观之一。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Muhahahaha!
Victory is mine!
Looks like you won't be getting
any Lemons for now! But feel free to challenge me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
穆哈哈哈！
胜利属于我！
看来你暂时拿不到柠檬了！但随时欢迎挑战我！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Afraid are we?
There's no fooling you:
I'm one of the best at games!
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
害怕了吗？
别想骗我：
我是游戏高手之一！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Hmm...
Now what can
I possibly do
with all these
Lemons?
scripts.translation:
[俊先生]
嗯...
这么多柠檬
我到底能拿它们
做什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jun]
Feel free to
ask me for help
any time, okay?
scripts.translation:

随时欢迎
向我求助，
好吗？

ingredients to make

泰式BBQ的

I'm selling chiles,
fish sauce, and some

you'll need. I'll sell

让我看看...
我在卖辣椒、
鱼露，还有一些

your Tom Yum Goong~

你的泰式BBQ~

如果你没有空间

money to buy what you
need from me.
scripts.translation:
[商人 通顿]
嗯...？
现在，看起来
你没有足够的钱
从我这里买你需要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
Don't say that.
My prices are always
reasonable. I want you to know
that I'm a respectable Merchant.
scripts.translation:

别这么说。
我的价格总是
合理的。我希望你知道
我是一个受人尊敬的商人。

with enough ingredients, but

know how much Tom Yum Goong
you're making.
scripts.translation:

我以为我提供了
足够的食材，但
现在想想，我不知道
你要做多少泰式BBQ。

Would you like to
buy some more Chilis?
scripts.translation:
[商人 通顿]
你想再买
一些辣椒吗？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

Fare well~
scripts.translation:

再见~

谢谢，

Hello there!

scripts.translation:
[商人 通顿]
你好！
你试过辣椒吗？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdom]
Despite its tiny appearance,
it has a very strong flavor. It's also hot and spicy, so you should be careful when you eat one.
scripts.translation:
[商人 通顿]
别看它个头小，味道却非常浓郁。而且又热又辣，吃的时候要小心哦。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
The people of Ayothaya enjoy sensational food with distinct, spicy flavors. In Ayothayan cuisine, we use things like Chilis, garlic, ginger and cilantro.
scripts.translation:
[商人 通顿]
哎哟泰雅的人们喜欢口味独特、辛辣刺激的食物。在哎哟泰雅的料理中，我们会使用辣椒、大蒜、姜和香菜等食材。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Thongdum]
I'm selling Chilis,
so if you need any,
please come to me~

如果你需要的话，
